title: Gold Plus Saver Account: Investment sweep integration
summary: The document explains that the Gold Plus Saver Account tier supports automatic investment sweeps: excess end-of-day available balances above a $50,000 threshold are swept to a linked investment account. Sweep activity may pause if balances move near the threshold, and sweep activity appears as transfers in transaction history with suggested reconciliation labeling.
